name: Eoconfuciusornis
sum: Oldest known beaked bird, a small confuciusornithid from about 131 million years ago in Hebei, China.
holotype: IVPP V11977, a compressed, fairly complete skeleton with most of its feathering, from near Sichakou, Fengning, Hebei.
biology: Smaller than Confuciusornis but very similar, with a pointed toothless beak.
author: Zhang et al. 2008
